family_name: Autex Cascade Acoustic Hanging Screens - Folding

spec.description:
Autex Cascade Acoustic Hanging Screens - Folding are suspended acoustic space
dividers that feature a patented 3D folding pattern cut into 12mm Cube panels.
By pushing and pulling open cut geometric folds, the screen creates
architectural depth, texture, and visual privacy without discarding any
off-cuts. Suspended from the ceiling, it absorbs ambient noise reflections and
reduces background chatter in commercial offices, educational facilities, and
hospitality venues.

Patented 3D folding geometric design
creates texture and shadow

Manufactured with zero cut-out waste for maximum
sustainability
Constructed from 12mm semi-rigid Cube polyester felt
Suspended via Frontier aluminium channel and adjustable wire kit

Provides
acoustic absorption while preserving line-of-sight and airflow

Available in

Group 1 fire rating to AS ISO 9705

spec.compliance:
NCC BCA Group 1 fire compliance; AS

install:
Mark ceiling
fixing points to match Frontier channel suspension slider positions

Fasten
ceiling connectors securely to structural ceiling or track

Attach Frontier
channel to the top edge of the 12mm folding screen

Push and pull individual
geometric tabs to create the 3D folding pattern

Connect suspension wires to
ceiling connectors and level the screen

Attach bottom channel if installing
in top-and-base fixed configuration

Fit end caps to channel ends for a clean
architectural finish
selection_checklist:
Choose folding pattern design
(e.g. F1, F2, F3, F7)
Select colour from Autex Cube palette

Verify ceiling
height and check if extended suspension wire is needed

Determine whether
free-hanging or base-anchored configuration is preferred

Check clearance from
high-velocity air conditioning diffusers
accessories:
Cascade
suspension kit (Frontier channel, ceiling connectors, 1m cables, sliders)
limitations: Not a structural partition or barrier

Avoid placement in
direct path of strong drafts or high air conditioning flow that could cause
swaying

Tabs should be folded carefully along pre-cut hinge lines to avoid
tearing

use_cases:
adding acoustic texture and visual screening
between project teams in agile corporate offices

separating collaborative
café zones from quiet desks in modern co-working hubs

creating an
eye-catching suspended backdrop behind reception desks to absorb foyer echo
dividing open spaces in galleries, showrooms, and retail stores
not_for: airborne sound containment requiring solid soundproof walls
wet rooms or high-humidity shower spaces
retrieval.rag_summary:
Autex Cascade Acoustic Hanging Screens - Folding are 12mm thick
suspended acoustic screens that feature push-and-pull three-dimensional
geometric folding patterns. Made from semi-rigid Cube polyester felt without
generating off-cut waste, the folded tabs create dynamic light and shadow
effects while capturing sound reflections in open interiors. Supported by an
aluminium Frontier channel kit, with Group 1 fire performance and 80% recycled
content, they deliver acoustic diffusion and visual separation for open-plan
workspaces.
